note: Cross-game radio manifest. Single source of truth — games load this + radio.js and never change when new stations/tracks are added. Tracks stream from their source URLs (no bundling). 8 stations: Polkahole (default) + the 3 Machine Elves originals + the 4 ShatterBlock originals. Originals are root-relative (served from /games/<game>/original/) so any game page can reach them. ShatterBlock originals re-synthesized 2026-11-14 with richer synths + live feel (detuned saw leads, sidechained bass, synced echo, FDN reverb, humanized timing/pitch).
